basic_info.description: Designed by acclaimed architect David Baker, this top-floor 2BD/2BA loft-style condo is bathed in natural light in the heart of Potrero Hill. The main level features high ceilings, wood floors, and floor-to-ceiling windows. The remodeled kitchen has sleek cabinets, SS appliances & ample counter space, with a full bath nearby. A versatile bedroom includes a Murphy bed & stylish barn door. Enjoy access to a deck & communal garden w/ BBQ. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts a sun-filled, south-facing deck, serene hillside views & an updated bath w/ premium finishes. In-unit laundry, secure garage parking w/ EV charger & extra storage. Expansive HOA areas include decks, lush landscaping & panoramic city views. Close to 18th St shops, cafes & Whole Foods, this move-in-ready home offers modern comfort in a prime location.
